answer_result.answer: Calvin said in a message timestamped 2023-10-15 that he got a new Ferrari "last week." Since he had already referred to owning a Ferrari on 2023-08-03, this is consistent with a second Ferrari, but the evidence does not give an exact purchase date; it was approximately the week before 2023-10-15.
